name: What safety considerations are important for fire-bowl installation?

mainEntity.name: What safety considerations are important for fire-bowl installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount for fire-bowl installations. Key considerations include maintaining adequate clearance from combustible materials such as structures, trees, and fencing. Proper ventilation is essential for gas units. The fire-bowl must be installed on a stable, non-combustible surface. Additionally, ensuring professional installation of gas lines to prevent leaks and adhering to all local fire codes are crucial for safe operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Important safety considerations include clearance from combustibles, proper ventilation, stable non-combustible surfaces, and professional gas line installation.
